title: cost-model-service: add load test harness + tune internal caching to hit p95 latency SLO
author: Sean Gallagher
release_notes:
- Internal: Adds repeatable load test harness for cost-model-service estimate/explain endpoints.
- Internal: Improves p95 latency under burst by adding request memoization + singleflight for catalog/pricing lookups and tightening cache bounds.
body: Problem: cost-model-service p95 latency regressed in staging once Console began calling /v1/estimate at higher concurrency; profiling showed repeated model-catalog + pricing-table resolution work and cache stampedes on cold start/rolls. This PR adds a reproducible load test harness and tunes internal caching so we can meet the p95 latency target under representative traffic without compromising determinism. Scope: (1) Load test harness (k6-based) with canned scenarios and a runner that can target local/staging/prod-canary, (2) service-side caching improvements: bounded in-process LRU for resolved cost inputs (catalog + sku + quant profile metadata), singleflight to collapse concurrent misses, and pre-warming on process start with an explicit safety cap, (3) extra service metrics to validate behavior (cache hit/miss, singleflight wait, catalog fetch latency, request queueing). Targets validated (staging): /v1/estimate p95 <= 120ms at 250 rps, 20 concurrent VUs, 2KB avg payload; /v1/explain p95 <= 180ms at 100 rps; error rate < 0.1%. Determinism: cache keys use normalized request (sorted maps, stable JSON canonicalization) + scm_version + resolved_model_id; cached values are pure inputs to the deterministic calculator (no time-dependent fields). Safety: cache sizes are bounded (by entry count and approximate bytes), and we avoid caching on validation errors; logs do not include customer prompts (only request_id/tenant_id hashed). Follow-ups: wire this harness into perf-canary for nightly drift detection and add a standard runbook section under SRE docs. Checklist: [x] Load test script + docs (README) [x] Bounded cache + singleflight [x] Metrics + dashboards hooks (names only; dashboard JSON in observability-pack) [x] Added CI smoke for harness lint + unit tests for cache key normalization [x] Staging run results attached in PR comment.
